title: Unresolved tax classification is not silently treated as exemption
question: Null lookup, zero rate and exemption have different meanings; rate source/effective date and matching criteria need policy.

evidence.title: Unresolved tax classification remains nullable and externally determined
explanation: Resolver returns null for no category or no matching repository result; supplied criteria augment or override its category criterion.
Null is not an exemption, zero rate or proof that tax does not apply. Repository ordering, uniqueness, caller-criteria overrides and historical rate selection require further reading.
